description: Gate story-complete on an actual commit existing (HEAD advanced), not just prd.json passes in the working tree, and give container workers a longer sentinel-timeout ceiling, so a timed-out worker's uncommitted passes:true no longer false-advances the loop to review.

userStories.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding
userStories.notes: CRITICAL [src/supervisor/result.ts:300]: commitSubjectMatchesStory anchors the id immediately after 'feat:' (regex ^feat:\s*<id>\s*-\s*\S), matching only the bracketless form 'feat: US-001 - Title'. The actual convention the worker emits is bracketed: 'feat: [Story ID] - [Story Title]' (templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md:100, templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md:12) and every real per-story commit on this branch is 'feat: [US-001] - ...'. Verified: commitSubjectMatchesStory('feat: [US-001] - Add commit-existence gate','US-001') returns false against the branch's own commit. The matcher cannot confirm the real commit convention, so US-001 AC7 (confirm a commit that follows the convention) is not met.

userStories.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding
userStories.notes: CRITICAL [src/supervisor/host.ts:626]: commitExistsForStory runs `git log --format=%s <branch>`, which walks the entire branch ancestry back to root (per git-scm.com/docs/git-log), not just commits unique to this PRD. Story ids (US-001..) are reused every PRD, so ancient bracketless commits collide: commitExistsForStory('US-001') returns true by matching 'feat: US-001 - tmux worker-slot primitives' (an unrelated months-old commit), NOT this branch's 'feat: [US-001] - ...'. The gate therefore returns true regardless of whether the current worker committed, silently defeating the exact 'passes:true but no commit' scenario the epic (CAM-187) exists to catch. Scope the lookup to commits unique to the branch (e.g. `git log --format=%s main..HEAD` or origin/main..HEAD).

userStories.title: Review round 1 fix 003: address reviewer finding
userStories.notes: WARNING [test/supervisor/result.test.ts:1283]: The commitSubjectMatchesStory tests only assert the bracketless 'feat: US-001 - ...' form (the wrong convention); no test asserts the real 'feat: [US-001] - ...' bracketed convention. The loop/host tests inject a fake commitExistsForStory, so no test exercises the real host.ts adapter against a real git log. Consequently the two CRITICAL defects pass CI green. Add a matcher test for 'feat: [US-001] - Title' and an integration test that runs the real adapter against a repo whose only matching commit is bracketed.

userStories.title: Add commit-existence gate to readWorkerOutcome
userStories.description: As the cam supervisor, I need readWorkerOutcome to confirm a story DONE only when prd.json passes:true AND a commit for that story exists, so a worker that flipped passes:true but never committed (e.g. staged-then-timed-out) does not get reported as a clean pass.
acceptanceCriteria: readWorkerOutcome accepts an optional commitExistsForStory(storyId) callback in ReadWorkerOutcomeOptions and consults it when confirming a DONE outcome. [oracle: grep -q 'commitExistsForStory' src/supervisor/result.ts]

A story that is passes:true in prd.json but for which commitExistsForStory returns false and requires !== 'operator' does NOT resolve to kind:'pass' (it is not confirmed DONE and will not advance to review). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

A story that is passes:true and for which commitExistsForStory returns true resolves to kind:'pass'; this holds in both the worker-report primary path and the handoff/sentinel fallback path. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

A story with requires:'operator' that is passes:true resolves to kind:'pass' even when commitExistsForStory returns false (operator ceremony exempt from the commit-existence gate). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

When commitExistsForStory is undefined (callback absent), readWorkerOutcome behaves exactly as before this change (no gate) and all pre-existing result.test.ts cases stay green. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]

src/supervisor/result.ts performs no direct git/child-process spawn; commit existence is reached only through the injected callback. [oracle: ! grep -qE 'spawnSync|Bun\.spawn|child_process' src/supervisor/result.ts]

An exported pure matcher confirms a commit whose subject follows the convention 'feat: <Story ID> - <Title>' (including review-fix ids like US-R1-003) and rejects a subject that only mentions the id incidentally, so a divergent commit message does not produce a false-positive DONE. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/result.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Full quality spine is green (bun run check:all: typecheck + biome lint + tests). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Edit src/supervisor/result.ts + test/supervisor/result.test.ts only. Gate BOTH storyPassesInPrd->pass sites: the worker-report primary path (~line 344) and the handoff/sentinel fallback path (~line 430). Extend the internal PrdJson story shape to also read `requires` (currently only {id, passes}) so the operator exemption can read it. Make commitExistsForStory OPTIONAL so existing callers (no callback yet) keep today's behavior verbatim (US-002 wires the real one). Keep the pure-function contract: no git spawn, all I/O via injected callbacks. The story-id token can contain internal hyphens (US-R1-003) per the sentinel regex US-[A-Za-z0-9-]+; the matcher must handle those. Commit convention is `feat: [Story ID] - [Story Title]` (scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md step 8). HINT on the not-DONE return kind: do NOT return a kind whose loop treatment routes to finalizeStory/auto-commit ('incomplete' triggers supervisor finalize, which is out-of-scope) - prefer a kind/detail that the loop treats as re-dispatch/no-progress (US-002 defines the loop behavior). Read scripts/cam/patterns.md at story start.

userStories.title: Wire commitExistsForStory from host + loop with anchored git detection
userStories.description: As the cam supervisor loop, I need a real commit-existence adapter injected so that in production a passes:true-without-commit story does not advance to review, it re-dispatches and is bounded by the existing anti-storm guard.
acceptanceCriteria: RunSupervisorOptions in src/supervisor/loop.ts gains an optional commitExistsForStory field that is threaded into the readWorkerOutcome call. [oracle: grep -q 'commitExistsForStory' src/supervisor/loop.ts]

src/supervisor/host.ts builds a real commitExistsForStory adapter that reads the current branch's commit subjects via git and matches them with the anchored matcher from US-001, and injects it into the RunSupervisorOptions it returns. [oracle: grep -q 'commitExistsForStory' src/supervisor/host.ts]

Loop behavior: given a worker whose advisory story is passes:true in prd.json but has no matching commit (adapter returns false, requires !== 'operator'), the loop does NOT advance to review. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]

The passes-without-commit outcome does NOT invoke finalizeStory to auto-commit the uncommitted work (supervisor auto-commit is out-of-scope); recurrence is bounded by the existing anti-storm guard so the loop blocks+escalates instead of spinning to MAX_ITERATIONS. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]
A requires:'operator' story with passes:true still completes at the loop level (the gate does not regress operator handling). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Full quality spine is green (bun run check:all: typecheck + biome lint + tests). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: loop.ts: add commitExistsForStory to RunSupervisorOptions (near the prdPath/handoffPath fields ~line 205-215), resolve it in the opts destructure, and pass it into the readWorkerOutcome({...}) call (~line 1095). host.ts: build the real adapter in makeRunSupervisorHostOptions and add it to the returned opts object (~line 679-721); implement it with spawnSync git like the existing helpers (host.ts:531-589), e.g. `git log --format=%s <branch>` for the current branch subjects, then match each with the US-001 anchored matcher. Gotcha (issue spec E-list): fixer commits (US-R1-*) must carry the story id in their subject for the gate to confirm them - the anchored matcher must accept that convention. loop.test.ts already injects nowMs/perWorkerTimeoutMs/workerIsolation and fake finalizeStory, so the loop-behavior and no-auto-commit assertions are testable with fakes. Requires US-001 (callback + matcher). Read scripts/cam/patterns.md at story start.

userStories.title: Worker-isolation-aware per-worker sentinel timeout ceiling
userStories.description: As the cam supervisor, I need container workers to get a longer per-worker sentinel-timeout ceiling than host workers, so long container stories (image rebuild + in-container test suites) do not hit the 30-min ceiling and trigger a premature timeout/re-dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria: src/supervisor/loop.ts exports DEFAULT_CONTAINER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS === 60*60*1000 (60 min) while DEFAULT_PER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS stays 30*60*1000 (30 min). [oracle: grep -q 'DEFAULT_CONTAINER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS' src/supervisor/loop.ts]

When opts.perWorkerTimeoutMs is unset, the loop selects the ceiling by workerIsolation: container -> DEFAULT_CONTAINER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS, host -> DEFAULT_PER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]

src/supervisor/host.ts uses the isolation-aware default when CAM_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS is unset (container -> 60min, host -> 30min); an explicit CAM_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS value still overrides both. [oracle: grep -q 'DEFAULT_CONTAINER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS' src/supervisor/host.ts]

A container worker is not timed out before the 60-min ceiling while a host worker still times out at the 30-min ceiling, verified with an injected clock. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Full quality spine is green (bun run check:all: typecheck + biome lint + tests). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: loop.ts: declare DEFAULT_CONTAINER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS next to DEFAULT_PER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS (~line 471); change the perWorkerTimeoutMs resolution (~line 624) so the fallback is isolation-aware using workerIsolation (resolved ~line 652) instead of a flat DEFAULT_PER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS. host.ts: the CAM_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS resolver (~line 243) must fall back to the isolation-aware default (workerIsolation resolved at host.ts:455) when the env var is unset; the explicit env value must still win. This sub-fix is independent of US-001/US-002 (requires null) - it only reduces how often the timeout fires; the commit gate makes the timeout SAFE regardless. loop.test.ts already injects nowMs, perWorkerTimeoutMs and workerIsolation, so the ceiling-selection test is straightforward. Read scripts/cam/patterns.md at story start.
